import math
import mir_eval

# Trim early beats (before 5s by default) as required by the evaluation standard
ref_beats_trimmed = mir_eval.beat.trim_beats(ref_events)
est_beats_trimmed = mir_eval.beat.trim_beats(est_events)

# Compute the information gain metric
score = mir_eval.beat.information_gain(ref_beats_trimmed, est_beats_trimmed, bins=41)

# Verify correctness: identical beats should yield an error histogram with all mass in one bin (entropy = 0).
# The information gain (K-L divergence to uniform) should therefore be exactly log2(bins).
if len(ref_beats_trimmed) > 2:
    score_identical = mir_eval.beat.information_gain(ref_beats_trimmed, ref_beats_trimmed, bins=41)
    expected_max_ig = math.log2(41)
    assert math.isclose(score_identical, expected_max_ig, rel_tol=1e-5), \
        f"Expected max information gain {expected_max_ig}, got {score_identical}"

print(f"__CHECK__ information_gain {score:.4f}")
